node.statement: For every a in S, f_ia=p_a>0, so the support graph contains the edge i->a. By node 1.1.3 no such edge can join distinct strongly connected components. Hence every a in S is in the component of i, so the support graph is strongly connected; together with nodes 1.1.1 and 1.1.2 this proves node 1.1.
